correctness.rationale: The primitive linear coordinate equation and isolated Jacobian singularity prove integral normality. The stated cubic and quartic plane forms meet in twelve transverse points over the field of four elements; blowing up their complete-intersection ideal resolves the four quartic generators and maps birationally to X. Exactly the three H-factor lines contract, each having self-intersection minus three and pairwise intersection plus one, yielding the minimal resolution. The complete local Jacobian quotient the displayed completed local Jacobian quotient has length sixteen. The Leray/Hypersurface cohomology computation yields local geometric genus one. Exact checker verifies polynomial identities and finite configuration, without assuming finite experimentation proves geometric completeness.

value.rationale: Schur is an extremal classical quartic whose reduction in characteristic two is a documented exceptional degeneration. An exact explicit rational minimal resolution, negative-definite contraction graph, 12 singular-point lines, genus-one non-rational singularity and intrinsic Jacobian length describe a natural entire special fibre and its singularity, beyond the familiar classical 64-line count. The result motivates further arithmetic reduction and surface singularity comparisons, although these are not claimed as corollaries.
